crossRefs.note: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.
In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for…
Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.
Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,
He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.
The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons…
There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:
All the people who were in the gate, and the elders, said, “We are witnesses. May Yahweh make the woman who has come…

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

people.name: Leah
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
translations.bsb: Now Laban had two daughters; the older was named Leah, and the younger was named Rachel.
translations.kjv: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
translations.asv: And Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
